## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the preview containment check before merge because traversal paths and symlinks can expose files outside the selected home directory. This review read every changed file and all repository tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a home-file preview limited to 200 characters, a settings-file path helper, and tests for both helpers.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before checking home containment — Calling `preview("/home/alice", "../bob/secret.txt")` returns the outside file’s contents when that file exists and is readable. `is_relative_to()` checks lexical ancestry without resolving `..` or symlinks, so the candidate passes this check and reaches `read_text()`. — Users can retrieve readable files outside the selected home directory, bypassing the preview’s access boundary. — Fix: Resolve both the home and candidate paths before checking containment, and add regression tests for parent traversal and symlinks pointing outside home.
